missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: What products have a stock count of 0 across all locations and have not been reordered within the last 90 days?

missions.name: Sizing Anomaly Analysis
missions.query: What product sizes have a standard deviation of size distribution across all locations greater than 1?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Risk
missions.query: Which suppliers have a lead time greater than 30 days and an on-time rate less than 80%?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Detection
missions.query: What products have a stock count less than their reorder point across all locations and have not been reordered within the last 30 days?

missions.name: Inventory Imbalance
missions.query: What products have a stock count imbalance greater than 20% across all locations?

missions.name: Supplier Performance Monitoring
missions.query: Which suppliers have a lead time greater than 20 days and an on-time rate less than 90% within the last 6 months?

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Analysis
missions.query: What channels have a sales growth rate greater than 20% within the last quarter and what products are driving this growth?

missions.name: Product Line Obsolescence
missions.query: What product lines have a sales decline rate greater than 15% within the last year and have not been reordered within the last 6 months?

missions.name: Identify dead stock products across all locations
missions.query: SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE stock_count = 0

missions.name: Detect sizing anomalies across products
missions.query: SELECT style_name, size FROM products GROUP BY style_name, size HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

missions.name: Find suppliers with lead times exceeding 30 days
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id FROM suppliers WHERE lead_time_days > 30

missions.name: Identify products with stock count below reorder point
missions.query: SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE stock_count < reorder_point

missions.name: Analyze on-time rate of suppliers
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id, AVG(on_time_rate) AS average_on_time_rate FROM suppliers GROUP BY supplier_id

missions.name: Analyze sales distribution across channels
missions.query: SELECT channel, SUM(units_sold) AS total_units_sold FROM sales_events GROUP BY channel

missions.name: Analyze unit cost and retail price ratio
missions.query: SELECT style_name, AVG(unit_cost) / AVG(retail_price) AS price_ratio FROM products GROUP BY style_name

missions.name: Analyze supplier geographic distribution
missions.query: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers GROUP BY country

missions.name: Size Distribution Inconsistency
missions.query: SELECT style_name, size, AVG(stock_count) AS average_stock_count FROM inventory GROUP BY style_name, size HAVING AVG(stock_count) < 10 OR AVG(stock_count) > 50

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variability
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id, AVG(lead_time_days) AS average_lead_time FROM suppliers WHERE lead_time_days > 20 GROUP BY supplier_id HAVING AVG(lead_time_days) > 30

missions.name: Inventory Imbalance by Location
missions.query: SELECT sku, location, stock_count, reorder_point FROM inventory WHERE stock_count < reorder_point AND sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE stock_count > reorder_point)

missions.name: Product Line Sales Decline
missions.query: SELECT style_name, SUM(units_sold) AS total_units_sold FROM sales_events WHERE sale_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY style_name HAVING SUM(units_sold) < 0.8 * (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM sales_events WHERE style_name = inventory.style_name)

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate Fluctuation
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id, AVG(on_time_rate) AS average_on_time_rate FROM suppliers WHERE on_time_rate < 80 GROUP BY supplier_id HAVING AVG(on_time_rate) > 0.9 * (SELECT AVG(on_time_rate) FROM suppliers WHERE supplier_id = products.supplier_id)

missions.name: Channel Sales Growth
missions.query: SELECT channel, SUM(units_sold) AS total_units_sold FROM sales_events WHERE sale_date > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 QUARTER) GROUP BY channel HAVING SUM(units_sold) > 1.2 * (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM sales_events WHERE channel = sales_events.channel)

missions.name: Dead Stock Identification
missions.query: SELECT sku FROM inventory WHERE stock_count = 0 AND last_restocked_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 MONTH)

missions.name: Supplier Delay Risk
missions.query: SELECT supplier_id, AVG(lead_time_days) AS average_lead_time FROM suppliers WHERE lead_time_days > 20 AND on_time_rate < 80 GROUP BY supplier_id HAVING AVG(lead_time_days) > 30

missions.name: Price Ratio Anomaly
missions.query: SELECT style_name, AVG(unit_cost) / AVG(retail_price) AS price_ratio FROM products GROUP BY style_name HAVING AVG(unit_cost) / AVG(retail_price) > 1.2

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Rate
missions.query: SELECT sku, inventory.turnover_rate FROM (SELECT sku, stock_count, reorder_point, last_restocked_at FROM inventory) inventory, (SELECT sku, AVG(lead_time_days) AS lead_time FROM suppliers GROUP BY sku) suppliers WHERE inventory.sku = suppliers.sku AND lead_time > 30 AND inventory.stock_count < reorder_point

missions.name: Supplier Country Concentration
missions.query: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 0.2 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suppliers)
